scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,green "npm run dev -w vinmeen-api" "npm run dev -w vinmeen-web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run icons -w vinmeen-web && npm run build -w vinmeen-web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w vinmeen-api
